authorization_fields_scope_owner_check.name: authorization_fields_scope_owner_check
authorization_fields_scope_owner_check.value: ("authorization_fields"."scope" = 'system' and "authorization_fields"."owner_id" is null) or ("authorization_fields"."scope" = 'custom' and "authorization_fields"."owner_id" is not null)

authorizations_kind_field_check.name: authorizations_kind_field_check
authorizations_kind_field_check.value: ("authorizations"."kind" = 'global_buyout' and "authorizations"."field_id" is null and "authorizations"."field_name_snapshot" is null) or ("authorizations"."kind" <> 'global_buyout' and "authorizations"."field_id" is not null and "authorizations"."field_name_snapshot" is not null)

inspiration_analyses_state_check.name: inspiration_analyses_state_check
inspiration_analyses_state_check.value:
(
        ("inspiration_analyses"."status" = 'pending'
          and "inspiration_analyses"."result" is null
          and "inspiration_analyses"."completed_at" is null
          and "inspiration_analyses"."error_code" is null)
        or ("inspiration_analyses"."status" = 'completed'
          and "inspiration_analyses"."sources" is not null
          and "inspiration_analyses"."result" is not null
          and "inspiration_analyses"."completed_at" is not null
          and "inspiration_analyses"."error_code" is null)
        or ("inspiration_analyses"."status" = 'failed'
          and "inspiration_analyses"."error_code" is not null
          and "inspiration_analyses"."result" is null)
      )
